The Problem

Operators run million-dollar businesses on gut and a monthly rear-view mirror.

QuickBooks stores the data. It doesn’t answer the questions that actually run the business — so between accountant closes, owners are blind for 30+ days at a time. Exactly when cash and vendor mistakes happen.

Q1
“How much cash can I safely spend today?”
Q2
“Which vendors do I pay first this week?”
Q3
“What changed since last week — and does it matter?”
Q4
“Are we going to hit the number?”

QuickBooks Online is the SMB system of record — ~7M+ businesses — with a real API. The financial data is finally addressable.

How It Works

Live in ten minutes. No contract uploads. No rebuilding your books.

1Connect QuickBooks

Secure OAuth. CommandIQ reads accounts, P&L, vendors, bills and payments — no manual setup.

2The engine scores it

A deterministic financial engine normalizes the ledger and computes every metric — reproducible and explainable.

3You get a command center

A live dashboard and an AI CFO that answers in plain terms — grounded in your real numbers.

Every number is deterministic and testable. The AI is grounded in real figures — it never makes numbers up.

Why We Win

The defensibility is in the decision layer.

01 — The decision layer

A proprietary scoring model and action workflow sit on top of the ledger. Competitors would have to rebuild the reasoning, not just the integration.

02 — Trustworthy AI

Grounded, deterministic answers earn the one thing finance software must have: trust. No hallucinated numbers, ever.

03 — Integration breadth

A roadmap that fuses financial + retail + customer + contractual data into one picture no point tool can match.

04 — Habit & data compounding

Daily use plus accumulating history make CommandIQ the system of record — and the harder it is to leave.
